sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref" AS e, "trader"."tradekind" AS g, AVG("sentimentandfundamentals"."optvolrt") AS m1, AVG((CAST("sentimentandfundamentals"."shortintrt" AS REAL) / "sentimentandfundamentals"."inholdpct")) AS m2 FROM "sentimentandfundamentals" JOIN "transactionrecord" ON "transactionrecord"."transreg" = "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref" JOIN "trader" ON "trader"."tradereg" = "transactionrecord"."trdref" GROUP BY "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref", "trader"."tradekind"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, (AVG("s1"."m1") - AVG("s1"."m2")) AS m3 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT AVG("s2"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s2"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s2"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s2"
construction: agg:transactionrecord within trader.tradekind > agg:g > diff > agg:all
